title: FOMC decision + SEP (meeting Jun 8-9) — the Fed's full projection set lands the morning the Bank of Japan's June 2027 MPM opens
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) and parsed out of the page's own 2027 panel, which reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*" with the footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections." — so June 8-9 DOES carry an SEP. Page's own stamp: "Last Update: August 19, 2026". Filed estimate not for want of a primary but because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" — the 2027-04-27/28 meeting is the confirming venue — and because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Statement time assumed 14:00 ET per the standing convention, not separately sourced. Discovered during the boj-decision-2027-06-11 initial research, checked 2026-09-05
notes: Proposed during the boj-decision-2027-06-11 initial research (2026-09-05) because the +/-5-day adjacency window around that event returned exactly ONE tracked entry — the event itself — and what the window had missed is a high-impact SEP FOMC two days earlier. The Bank of Japan's June 2027 MPM is Jun 10-11 (boj-decision-2027-06-11, estimate, per boj.or.jp's own 2027 schedule table parsed the same day, whose Outlook column carries a '-' for that row). Sequencing, on standing publication conventions rather than a sourced clock: the FOMC statement publishes 14:00 ET Wed Jun 9 (June is UTC-4, so approx. 03:00 JST Thu Jun 10) with the press conference roughly 30 minutes later — i.e. before the MORNING OF MPM DAY 1. The Bank of Japan therefore deliberates both days with the Fed's full Summary of Economic Projections already public, and then publishes NO Outlook Report of its own. That is the EXACT INVERSION of the Q2 2027 pairing seven weeks earlier: at Apr 27-28 the BoJ went first with a full Outlook Report and the Fed followed with no SEP (fomc-2027-04-28). Across 2026 no meeting occupies this cell — 2026-07-31 matched the day-1 timing without an SEP, 2026-03-19 matched the SEP but landed on the BoJ's decision day. The practical consequence recorded in that ledger: the ordering is an ATTRIBUTION fact and NOT a predictive one — 2026's two Fed-first BoJ decisions are the year's largest (-1.66% on 07-31) and among its smallest (-0.47% on 03-19) decision-day yen moves, n=2 at opposite extremes, so nothing in the Tokyo sessions of 10-11 June may be attributed to either central bank. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS THE OTHER RATE ENTRIES: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or FX-keyed; term premium is second-order and already owned by the FOMC ledgers. Estimate widens caution only. Two things for the pulses: confirm the date once the 2027-04-27/28 meeting ratifies the calendar, and check whether the blackout arithmetic holds (second Saturday before a Tuesday start = 2027-05-29), the same open question fomc-2027-01-27 and fomc-2027-04-28 both carry — no blackout entry is proposed here because 2027-05-29 falls outside this event's own +/-5-day corridor.
